description:
Metadata for one structural unit, addressed by its URN.

`urn` is 'urn:ua:law:{nreg}:{path}@{YYYYMMDD}'. Drop '@{YYYYMMDD}' for today's
edition; drop the path too for the whole document. Take one from a filtered
`get_document_toc` rather than building it.

A URN resolving to no unit answers 'not_found' with the nearest real units
either side and `same_segment` -- real paths ending in the segment asked for,
the hint when the right article was guessed under a wrong ancestor.
name: ua_law__get_unit
title: Get Legal Provision Metadata
